production_scope: Only ordinary cancellation callback and scene-owned confirmation/identity/lifecycle integration in game/rear_base/base_demo.gd. Count and bay repairs remain separate.
source_observations: Opening actual nonempty consumed batch records current session/model/activity/duty/selection/recipe/batch identities and formats loss text from batch.receipt counts, current output and facility, without cancellation or reconciliation.
Empty batch invokes existing owner.cancel/stop directly, retaining Heavy cancellation of accepted-but-unconsumed order promises without a pointless consumed-loss prompt.
Keep/Escape/close clears only the UI request and hides the window. No domain mutation, reconciliation, speed change or implicit time freeze. Keep button explicitly receives focus after popup.

Confirm copies the pending dictionary, clears it before revalidation, compares exact current identities, then calls captured owner.cancel only. It never cancels a newly resolved different activity. Duplicate direct confirm sees empty request.

Existing shared-state subscription now passes through one thin handler retaining old refresh and checking only a nonempty pending decision. Model replacement, selected context/facility/recipe change and control reload invalidate stale decisions.
New handlers disconnect on node exit; new-model bind clears UI request. No persistent batch/receipt history, timer, deferred owner or frame polling.
Existing recipe-confirmation code, Pause command, domain Fixed/Heavy cancel, consumed-loss/refund/output-promise rules, costs/rates/finished goods unchanged.
